Maria: Post-game follow-ups from yesterday's regional failover. Capturing remediation owners, timelines, and recurring patterns. Please add action items you own and ETA.
Aj: I'll own 'multi-region routing rule validation' — plan: synthetic requests + traceroute checks. ETA Mon 2026-03-30.
Sam: I'll take 'backup restore runbook' — found gaps restoring metadata and timestamps. I'll update /runbooks/regional-failover/restore.md and add explicit verification steps (checksum, timeline, smoke queries). ETA Fri 2026-03-27.
Ellen: Noted a recurring pattern: cache warmup + massive KV miss rate right after failover driving CPU spikes. Proposed mitigation: staged priming + KV cache prefill and limit cold-request fanout. Can pair with Aj for routing/priming overlap.
Ravi: I'll run a game-day on 2026-04-07 to exercise routing + restore steps. I'll create the calendar invite + checklist. Need storage lead to own backup restore task during the exercise.
devops-bot: Reminder: scheduled failover game-day created by @Ravi for 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC — <https://cal.example/rdw-game-day-0407>
Maria: Quick action list for tracking:
  1) Routing validation — Aj — 2026-03-30 — add canary tests + perf criteria
  2) Restore runbook updates — Sam — 2026-03-27 — include canonical buckets, verification commands
  3) Cache warmup plan — Ellen / Ravi — 2026-04-03 — prototype prefill approach
  4) Backup encryption & KMS check — ops-oncall — 2026-03-28 — confirm rotation + access
Please add ticket links and blockers.
ops-oncall: I'll check backup KMS rotation and run a dry-run restore this week. Will post logs and S3 object listing here after tests. Canonical bucket is s3://redwood-db-backups-prod — marking legacy bucket deprecated in runbook.
Sam: Quick Q: can someone confirm the canonical bucket? saw s3://redwood-db-backups-legacy in a script. @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: Confirmed — canonical is s3://redwood-db-backups-prod. I'll update runbook and add an explicit 'verify bucket path' step in restore.md.
Aj: For routing tests, I'll add an automated canary that hits region fallback paths and validates p95 latency and correct origin routing. Will open PR in infra repo and link it here.
Ellen: For cache warmup, propose prepopulating the top-50 keys for 15 minutes after failover; will prototype in staging and report perf numbers. If we see >20% CPU reduction, iterate on 100 keys.
Ravi: I added an initial checklist gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 (contains steps, contact list, rollback notes). I'll expand it after Sam's runbook updates.
Maria: Two follow-ups from me: (a) please add owner + ticket link next to each action item in this thread, (b) I'll schedule a short recurring "DR follow-ups" sync Tuesdays 09:30 PT until game-day.
Sam: I'll create tickets for runbook update + bucket cleanup and paste links here when done.
Aj: tagging @infra-team for review of canary tests and routing rules.
Maria: Thanks all — let's prioritize high-risk items (backups + restores) first. Post blockers here or DM me. :thumbsup:
